---
name: Methodology & Evidence Boundary Feedback
about: Report false cognitive claims, fabricated standard citations, or mathematical errors.
title: "[METHODOLOGY] "
labels: methodology, quality-gate
assignees: ''
---

**Area of Concern**
- [ ] Mathematical derivation / Dimensional conversion
- [ ] Statistical claim (e.g. sample size, power analysis, Macro vs Micro average)
- [ ] Standard or regulation citation (e.g. ISO, IEC, AAMI, NHTSA)
- [ ] Cognitive mechanism assertion (e.g. Action Slips, Fitts's Law, KLM)
- [ ] Epistemic boundary breach (e.g. treating synthetic fixture as empirical data)

**Detailed Description of the Error**
Explain why the current reasoning or reference assertion is flawed, citing authoritative sources.

**Proposed Correction**
Provide the scientifically defensible correction adhering to the 7-element schema (Verified Facts, Valid Calculations, Acceptable Interpretations, Competing Explanations, Unsupported Claims, Method Boundaries, Minimum Validation).
